scope: Saved JLC listing observations for the active fitted identities. Not current stock, a quote, a reservation, a lead time or assembly acceptance; refresh before ordering. Quantities are fitted pieces x modules before attrition.

field_meanings.note: Fields read from each part page payload (componentInfo). library from componentLibraryType (base = Basic, expand = Extended); in_stock from overseasStockCount, which the 2026-11-06 A5 audit mapped to the UI "In Stock"; preorder_available from canPresaleNumber; preorder_minimum from preMinPurchaseNum. loss_number and least_patch_number are recorded without an established meaning. pcba_type and assembly_type are the "PCBA Type" and "Assembly Type" labels shown on the same rendered part pages (raw_sha256 covers that HTML).

not_one_snapshot: Rendered part pages and the parts-API audit are separate reads at different times; their stock figures differ for 25 identities and neither is a simultaneous supplier snapshot.

parts_api_calculated_total.excludes: Setup, stencil, joints, hand soldering, handling, PCB fabrication, shipping and taxes. Whether through-hole parts (J1, J2, J5, adapter J1/J2) count toward feeder loading is not stated on the fee page.

retired.reason: SW1 replaced by HX MSK13C02 (C5149819) on 2026-11-12 (owner decision switch-supply); historical evidence only

listing_page.identity_matched: LCSC code and MPN (the receipt carries no manufacturer field)

currency.basis: JLC API price rows carry no currency field. We read them as USD because the C221842 tier price 3.0325 is the figure the owner's live check saw in USD on the JLC detail page (supply-observations.json). Fee figures are USD as printed on the JLC fee page.

calculated.rule: pieces_to_buy = max(pieces_required + loss_number, least_patch_number, min_purchase); line_cost = pieces_to_buy x the price tier for that quantity. Field meanings are our reading of an undocumented API.
